intent: A stated judgment, argued honestly, with its own limits visible.

evidence_burden.rationale: A view earns its keep by reasoning, not citation volume. Facts it does assert are still verified.

flexibility: Free-form. The only structural requirement is that the position appears before its support.
anti_patterns: Opinion written in the register of neutral research
Counterarguments stated in a weakened form so they can be dismissed
Confidence asserted as high with no stated uncertainty
Burying the position under three paragraphs of context

quality_gates.rationale: Low by design. A view earns its keep by reasoning, not citation volume; holding it to the News floor would penalise the register rather than the writing.
